runtimeTexturePolicy: Use each frame.image relative to this manifest directory. The public sprite API has no atlas UV rectangle; atlas rects are authoring/preview metadata only.

placement.player: Draw a 64x64 logical-pixel quad at (body.x*tile-12, body.y*tile-8) when tile=64; scale all offsets by tile/64. Collision reference is 40x56, do not stretch artwork into the body rectangle.
placement.echo: Draw a 64x64 quad at (body.x*tile-12, body.y*tile); collision reference is 40x64. Same foot anchor as player.
placement.devices: Default stretch_to_authored_bounds. For tile_height_bottom_anchor (plate/spring/checkpoint), draw one tile HIGH with bottom=device.y+device.h; width=device.w*tile. For tile_height_top_anchor (platform/lift), draw one tile HIGH with top=device.y; width=device.w*tile. Do not shrink an entire plate PNG into its thin sensor height. Artwork never changes collision geometry.
placement.terrain: Select exposed-edge/corner frames. Repeat at one tile per frame; use fill for interior cells, never stretch a single bordered tile over the whole room.
placement.direction: All left/right/up/down variants are baked; no UV mirroring needed.

readability: Warm-white player; cyan echo; pale-jade terrain rims; amber state accents; muted coral danger. No bloom baked in, no text baked in.
